name: Sarang Han Jan Marajuseyo!
source:
A tale of love and self-discovery told through the eyes of a wandering martial artist who unexpectedly becomes a bartender. Serve cocktails, meet extraordinary patrons, and nurture bonds that blossom into romance in a modern wuxia-inspired world. 

[From [url=https://store.onstove.com/en/games/102434]STOVE[/url]]
translation:
通过一位意外成为调酒师的流浪武术家的视角讲述了一个关于爱情和自我发现的故事。在现代武侠世界中，提供鸡尾酒、会见非凡的顾客并培养浪漫的关系。

[来自[url=https://store.onstove.com/en/games/102434]STOVE[/url]]
